body.statement: If \(K=1\) and \(p_T(x)>0\Rightarrow p_1(x)>0\), then \(a_{1x}=p_T(x)\) uniquely and \[V_{\mathrm{coll}}(P,\theta)=\sum_{x\in\mathcal X}\frac{p_T(x)^2q_{1x}(\theta)}{n_1p_1(x)}.\] Thus the collection objects reduce algebraically to their one-source residual-variance forms.
body.justification: This is the required \(K=1\) sanity check.
body.gap: No novelty or procedural equivalence is claimed for this algebraic corollary.
body.consumer: Single-trial analyses recover the familiar inverse-cell-mass formula.
